Ancient Mega Pack Tome

Um antigo tomo encadernado em couro envelhecido, adornado com ornamentos dourados intricados. No centro encontra-se um padrão geométrico complexo que se assemelha à Flor da Vida. Dentro de seu coração pulsa uma energia misteriosa, como um farol chamando aos buscadores do conhecimento antigo. As páginas contêm segredos de artefatos antigos espalhados pelas terras de Faerûn, e da arte proibida de sua reencarnação. Julgando pelos dedos gordurosos em algumas páginas, este tomo já mudou de mãos várias vezes.

**Translation:**
---
**1. Introduction**
I've always been a big fan of *Baldur's Gate 3*, and I've spent a lot of time thinking about how to make the game more fun and engaging. Over the years, I've created a number of mods and tools to enhance the experience, but I've always felt like there was something missing. That's when I decided to create **AMP (Advanced Mod Pack)** — a comprehensive mod that brings together all my favorite features, fixes, and enhancements into one cohesive package.
AMP is not just a collection of mods; it's a complete reimagining of the game experience. It adds new mechanics, improves existing ones, and introduces a variety of optional features that can be toggled on or off depending on your preference. Whether you're looking for more challenge, more loot, or a more streamlined gameplay experience, AMP has something for you.
---
**2. Features of AMP**
- **Randomized Adamantine Moulds**: These powerful crafting materials are now randomized, giving you a chance to find them in the Grymforge/Underdark area. - **Training Ring**: A new item that allows you to summon the Tutorial Chest, making it easy to retrieve lost items. - **Tooltip Settings**: Customize how much information you see when hovering over items. - **Game Mode Selection**: Choose between Normal, Hard, and Casual modes. - **Pyre Mechanic**: A hidden fire that builds during boss fights, increasing enemy strength. - **ULTRA Mode**: A secret overlay that introduces Mirror Support, where bosses summon champions to chase you. - **Avarice Toggle**: An optional feature that increases boss rewards and merchant loot. - **Auto-Loot and Auto-Sell**: Automatically pick up and sell junk items, leaving artifacts for you. - **Enemy Scaling and Progression**: Enemies scale to your party's level, and each boss kill gives a permanent strength boost. - **Quest and Boss Reward System**: Enhanced rewards for completing quests and defeating bosses. - **Trials of Tav Shop**: A new shop in camp where you can buy capsules, coins, and shards. - **Compatibility with Other Mods**: AMP is designed to work well with other mods, though some may require additional configuration.
---
**3. How to Use AMP**
- **Installation**: Download the latest version of AMP from mod.io and install it through your mod manager. - **Settings**: Open the AMP Settings menu via the Training Ring to customize your experience. - **Game Modes**: Choose your preferred difficulty and gameplay style. - **Troubleshooting**: If you encounter issues, check the FAQ section or reach out to the community on Discord.
---
**4. FAQ**
**Q: Where did the adamantine moulds go?** **A:** Since they grant access to some of the strongest artifacts in the game, they've been randomized too. Fortunately, you can only find them in the Grymforge/Underdark area. On average, you'll find 4 moulds, but there's no guarantee which ones. If you enable Casual mode, all moulds are teleported to you at game start.
**Q: How do I get the Training Ring if I lost it?** **A:** Summon the Tutorial Chest! Yeah, it's that easy. There are tons of mods for this in the manager, just search: "Tutorial Chest" — and install any of them. You can also find the ring for sale from Volo and Rolan.
**Q: The tooltips are driving me crazy, how do I turn them off?** **A:** Open AMP Settings in the Training Ring → Tooltip Settings and pick the mode that works for you.
**Q: How do I change the game mode?** **A:** Open AMP Settings in the Training Ring → Game Mode.
**Q: What's the Pyre? My enemies suddenly got terrifying in the middle of a boss fight.** **A:** It's a hidden fire that builds during boss battles the faster you blitz, empowering every surviving enemy through ten stages. Ease off the pace, or hit foes with Acid and Radiant to cool it down. Full details in the **"Pyre"** chapter.
**Q: A mini-boss appeared in the middle of my fight and started chasing me. What is that?** **A:** That's ULTRA's Mirror Support, a secret overlay you opted into. A cornered boss called in a Mirror champion. Kill the summoned pursuer for bonus rewards. See the **"ULTRA Mode"** chapter.
**Q: What is Avarice?** **A:** An optional generosity toggle that makes boss rewards richer and stocks merchants with bonus loot. Off by default; flip it from AMP Settings. See **"Quest and Boss Rewards"**.
**Q: Items are getting picked up and sold on their own. Is that a bug?** **A:** No — that's auto-loot and auto-sell, which you can configure or turn off in AMP Settings. They only grab junk and leave real artifacts for you.
**Q: I can't click the Accept button on quest rewards, the hotbar is covering it?** **A:** Try minimizing the hotbar by clicking the Minus icon at the bottom right. If that doesn't help, make sure you're using a modern monitor, or install Vova's Hotbar.
**Q: How do I download an older version?** **A:** Go to the mod's page on mod.io, find the file history on the right side, and download the version you need using the changelog as reference. This is useful if you're playing with a console friend and need matching versions.
**Q: My game is crashing and I think it's because of AMP?** **A:** This can happen in combat with mods that increase the party size limit. It used to be an issue but shouldn't be anymore. If nothing helps, switch to Casual mode.
**Q: PS5 update won't download?** **A:** Try tethering through your phone's mobile data — I've heard that gets the download to work.
**Q: The console version is behind, when will you update it?** **A:** It's already updated. If the version is behind — that's entirely on Larian, since they're the ones who need to hit the Approve button.
**Q: Where did ring and weapon crafting go?** **A:** Removed a long time ago.
**Q: Where did the camp stations and the big altar go?** **A:** Removed a long time ago.
**Q: What does "also" and "additionally" mean in effect descriptions?** **A:** "Also" means the damage is a damage rider, i.e., bonus damage, while "additionally" means the damage is standalone. Bonus damage needs something to attach to, and some damage sources may refuse riders entirely — while standalone damage can collect bonus damage on top of itself.
**Q: How do we split loot between players?** **A:** I dunno, roll a die or something?
**Q: Can I disable one specific feature?** **A:** Many of the optional systems can be switched off in AMP Settings. For anything not exposed there, you'd need to create a submod and remove it on your end.
**Q: I installed AMP mid-playthrough, should I start over?** **A:** Yes.
**Q: If I don't like it, can I remove everything?** **A:** Yes, but your save might break. You'll also obviously lose all items. The game typically crashes at 83% loading.
**Q: How does difficulty progression work? Why did enemies get stronger?** **A:** Every fight scales to your party's average level, and on top of that, each major boss kill gives all enemies a small permanent stack. This works in Normal and Hard modes. Details in the **"Enemy Scaling and Progression"** chapter.
**Q: Any recommendations for a 4-player co-op group?** **A:** Start with Normal mode. Toward the end of Act 2, you can switch to Hard through the Training Ring — four characters geared up with **AMP** artifacts will be plenty strong by then.
**Q: What's a Planar Emporium / that shop thing in camp?** **A:** That's the **Trials of Tav Shop** — a big barrel where you can buy capsules, coins, and shards for gold. More details in its own chapter.
**Q: If I update AMP on an existing save, will all the new features work?** **A:** Most of them — yes, but new scripted features (new quest rewards, new boss reward windows, new shard mechanics) require a fresh playthrough. This is a fundamental limitation of Osiris scripts, which don't carry over to existing saves.
---
**5. Community and Support**
- **Discord**: Join the community on Discord for support, tips, and updates: [discord.gg/X8BQxYhvNW](https://discord.gg/X8BQxYhvNW) - **Special Thanks**: A big thank you to everyone who helped with bugs and overall mode balance, including: Demps, Gumsoul, Hammerbro, Jerovich, Lakil, Moezilla, Never, Ryz, Renee, sidj, Sliebheinne, Solo Giallo, TacticalFox27, top5g04t, Triode, wh1te_ghost, Zanth, GGtsune, Zy, menuk, Zetsubow, KPW99, Gab, Flex, CloudCTRL, cjm, Hatul, Fernanda, Kang, Kerp, Tallo4ok, *Ultrapoor*, Ezze, Khaal, Kirill Freydin, and many more.
---
**6. Conclusion**
AMP is more than just a mod — it's a way to experience *Baldur's Gate 3* in a new and exciting way. Whether you're looking for more challenge, more loot, or a more streamlined gameplay experience, AMP has something for you. I hope you enjoy it as much as I did creating it.
Thank you for reading, and happy gaming! 🎮

Uma faixa de cobre amarelado envolta uma ametista que pulsa com ritmo violeta. As incrustações ósseas formam formas que sugerem matéria cerebral — um presente, supostamente, de algo que pensou demais. O metal vibra levemente contra pensamentos.

O Cerebral Matrix Illithid contido neste anel foi extraído de um Cérebro Velho que morreu sonhando com a liberdade. Os relevos ósseos são fragmentos desse cérebro, ainda processando. Os sonhos persistem. O anel sussurra sugestões que geralmente são úteis e ocasionalmente assustadoras.

Este anel mental liga o portador à Consciência Infinita — a rede teórica de todos os seres pensantes. O ametista pulsa com ondas psiónicas; os padrões cerebrais ósseos ao seu redor atuam como antenas. A conexão é fraca, como ouvir uma multidão de longe. Mas a multidão ouve de volta.
O anel não pensa. Todos os pensamentos ocorrem dentro do anel, e parte deles vazam para fora.

Um vasto cinto de brasa preto, com um grande rubi da cor do sangue secado. As garras que seguram a pedra parecem agarrar mais do que colocar. Os símbolos de Bhaal estão trabalhados no metal. O rubi pulsa quando segurado.

A Autoridade do Sangue do Senhor foi transmitida entre os sacerdotes principais de Bhaal até a primeira morte do deus. O coração de cada sacerdote é capturado nas rubis dispersas ao redor da pedra principal. Ele lembra cada batida. Anel acelera quando a violência está perto — não como aviso, mas como antecipação.

Sete assassinatos consecraram este anel soberano — não matarás aleatórios, mas sacrifícios precisos oferecidos por aqueles que entendiam o que estavam comprando. Os símbolos de Bhaal brilham suavemente quando sangue é derramado. O anel concede autoridade sobre a própria vida: onde ela vai, como rápido ela flui, quando ela acaba.
O anel não contém sangue. Todo sangue contém uma fragmento do anel.

Uma banda de adamantina escura adornada com obsidiana que parece conter profundidades. Riscos violetas dançam dentro — não reflexos, algo diferente. Ladrões usam essas alianças acreditando que ajudam na furtividade; a crença ajuda mais do que o anel, mas o anel também ajuda.

O Sombra Apegada aprisionada neste anel gótico foi capturada de uma escuridão demoníaca moribunda — o último segredo que ela tentou esconder. Os carmesim em espiral do obsidiana são pistas da escuridão da Sombrafell se infiltrando. O anel faz sombras mais profundas do que a geometria permite. Coisas ocultas permanecem ocultas por mais tempo.

Os Infiltradores de Shar passam esse anel de sombra entre agentes, cada um adicionando uma camada de escuridão antes de passá-lo adiante. Dezessete camadas agora cobrem as profundezas do obsidiano; as espirais violetas são ecos de Shar mesma. Ninguém se lembra do que o original parecia. É possível que ninguém tenha visto claramente.

Uma serpente de mithril escuro envolta uma esmeralda turva, seu olho peridóto brilhando suavemente. As escamas da serpente estão individualmente esculpidas; sua cabeça parece prestes a atacar. As inclusões na esmeralda se movem quando observadas de perto.

Este anel de serpente contém veneno que nunca encontrou algo que não pudesse corromper — incluindo antigos proprietários. As inclusões tóxicas da esmeralda deslizam lentamente pelo pedra; o olho de peridóto da serpente de mithril acompanha o movimento. Três alquimistas morreram criando-o, dois por veneno, um por ironia. O anel respeita o compromisso.

Talona's chosen wear this serpent-ring as proof of her blessing — the gift of understanding that poison and medicine are the same thing viewed from different angles. The snake's scales are individual prayers to corruption; its emerald heart contains venom from every poisonous creature. The ring ensures the wearer is always viewing from the correct angle.
O anel não é venenoso. A veneno é como o anel demonstra afeto.

Uma bela faixa de prata polida com um diamante perfeito em um suporte de seis garras. O metal reflete a luz perfeitamente — demasiado perfeitamente, como se estivesse sendo assistido. Magos sentem a Teia fluindo com mais suavidade perto dele.

A Radiância Estelar aprisionada neste signet foi capturada de uma estrela moribunda — não sua luz, mas seu propósito. O diamante impecável capta luz de espectros que não deveriam existir. O prata polido em espelho reflete futuros, e não rostos. Anel torna a magia mais fácil, mais suave, mais disposta a cooperar.

Os Escolhidos de Mystra usam este anel de platina como prova de seu favor — a benção de compreensão de que a magia não é uma ferramenta, mas uma coisa viva que deseja ser útil. As seis garras que seguram o diamante não são metal, mas vontade cristalizada. O anel introduz o portador à Teia, pessoalmente.
O anel não canaliza magia. A magia canaliza através de tudo porque o anel sugeriu que poderia ser divertido.
